properties.authority: Wildlife Act, Closed Areas Regulation (B.C. Reg. 76/84), Sch. 3, s. 45
properties.source_text:
Schedule 3 No Shooting or Hunting Areas (Section 4)
Cowichan Lake
45 That portion of the Province of British Columbia in the vicinity of Cowichan Lake, Cowichan Lake District, which is contained within the following described boundaries: Commencing on Highway 18 at the junction of the Youbou Road and Lake Cowichan road; thence 100 m due North of the centre line of said junction; thence following parallel to the Youbou section of Highway 18 to Youbou; thence continuing 100 m north and parallel of the main private industrial road along the north shore of Cowichan Lake to the most western point of the lake, thence following the main private industrial road along the west and south shore of Cowichan Lake to Honeymoon Bay; thence along Highway 18 from Honeymoon Bay to the village of Lake Cowichan; thence continuing along the said highway to the point of commencement, and including all of the intervening land and waters except Indian reserve lands and organized territory. [en. B.C. Reg. 80/2012, App. 1, s. 2.]
